scope: Geographical compilation and asset provenance; historical narrative evidence remains in ../research.json.

contract.projection: Lambert conformal conic; parallels 30.8/31.5, central meridian 121.425E; generated by tools/geo/emit_frame.mjs, never hand-edited frame.json.

maskBits.0: CN combat theatre, excluding the schematic foreign-defended core
maskBits.1: JP native home land, intentionally zero inside this Chinese bbox
maskBits.6: other land including the schematic foreign-defended core

contract.controlPolicy: Japanese local footholds and advances are represented only by the campaign-builder's time-dependent fronts. The world_1938 cache is not an August 1937 occupation map and is not consulted by this campaign's borders script.

pipeline.verify: GEO_CAMPAIGN=shanghai-1937 sh tools/py.sh campaigns/shanghai-1937/pipeline/geo/verify.py && node tools/geo/emit_frame.mjs shanghai-1937 --check
pipeline.localInsertion: The wrapper calls the unchanged shared tools in their normal order, inserting supplement.py after vectors and before project/render/masks. A plain shared geo/run.sh invocation omits this campaign-local post-vectors step; use the wrapper for rebuilding the final map.
pipeline.cache: Natural Earth and world_1938 raw downloads all reused .cache/geo/raw. Nine z9 Terrarium tiles x427..429/y208..210 were absent and downloaded once; subsequent runs reuse .work/geo/shanghai-1937/dem.npy with the frozen frame. Existing .venv and tools/py.sh were used; no installation.
pipeline.noSharedEdits: No shared engine or geography tool, other campaign, campaign.json or teammate-owned historical data was modified. No generator rerun, git commit or push.

basemap.actualUse: Existing cached ne_10m_land and coarse river/lake vectors; Natural Earth source scale 1:10 million.
basemap.limits: Modern coast and generalized physical geography. Historical reclamation, changing Yangtze/Hangzhou Bay shorelines, small waterways and urban expansion are not reconstructed by this dataset.

basemap.actualUse: Nine z9 tiles projected to dem.npy; terrain/height.png uses rg16 at 0.25m encoding precision, not 0.25m source accuracy.
basemap.limits: Modern, roughly 260m native horizontal pixels at Shanghai latitude; building/vegetation effects, smoothing, interpolation and bathymetric error. No claim to 1937 topography, tactical embankment heights or river depth.

basemap.actualUse: Already present in shared cache and checked by shared fetch step only. Not used to generate local political ownership.
basemap.limits: Postdates this campaign and must not be read as August 1937 occupation. All Chinese land in the local frame remains CN theatre land except the explicitly schematic foreign-defended core.

readGeographicText.method: AnySearch extract; river origin/mouth, name and modern waterfront passages read
readGeographicText.supports: Wenzaobang connects the Wusong River in the Huangdu/Anting region eastwards to Wusong and the Huangpu, across Jiading and Baoshan.
readGeographicText.limits: Text is not a georeferenced channel trace or a history of specific channel works. It does not establish unchanged 1937 widths or bends; only the broad connection is used.

riverCompilation.naturalEarthComponent: Cached unnamed river feature rivernum 582 joins western Wusong/Suzhou with the lower Huangpu. Its upstream reach west of 121.302745E is preserved, and its lower Huangpu vertices are reused. The coarse urban connector is replaced, not left as a duplicate river.
riverCompilation.urbanComponent: Schematic anchor-based connections constrained by the Sihang north-bank building, Tibet Road Bridge relationship, the Suzhou/Huangpu confluence and the north-suburban west-east water-obstacle sequence. Bends between these anchors are interpolated for comprehension, not digitized historical or modern surveyed channels.
riverCompilation.widthWarning: Fixed water corridors exist only to keep the 2D river, paper-map water, 3D albedo and physical-land mask consistent. The widths are visual schematics, not historical bank measurements. The approximately63m field grid may omit very narrow portions; do not infer fordability or a tactical crossing point. An initial126m grid misclassified the Sihang north-bank building by cell-centre aliasing; the finer grid corrects that without moving the documented site or changing projection.
riverCompilation.sharedWaterGeometry: supplement.py subtracts the same illustrative corridors from land, land_render and country polygons and adds their fills as water features to the lakes render layer; actual named centre lines remain in rivers. River fills are tagged waterway, not asserted to be lakes.

baoshanLandRepair.problem: Natural Earth1:10m land and its modern administrative coast both put the confirmed Linjiang Park / old Baoshan county-town neighbourhood roughly0.7–1km into water.
baoshanLandRepair.method: Only inside bbox[121.46,31.39,121.505,31.43], sample the already-cached projected Terrarium DEM in8x8-pixel blocks (about250m). Union blocks whose mean elevation is at least1m, retain components connected to existing Natural Earth land, and merge them into land/land_render/CN before carving the illustrative rivers. No new data download and no invented coastline vertices.
baoshanLandRepair.limits: This is a local modern-land consistency repair, not a measured1937 shoreline, seawall, city-wall footprint or proof that postwar reclamation did not occur. Thresholding a modern coarse DEM cannot reconstruct a historical tide line; the250m sampling itself is approximate.
baoshanLandRepair.sameGeometry: The repaired land reaches the vectors, paper tiles,3D albedo and control-land mask together. Field masks are then generated by the unchanged shared masks.py and their metadata is annotated by the local script.

foreignDefendedCore.method: A deliberately conservative inset city region expressing documented adjacency and continued foreign defence. The vertices are original schematic choices within the central foreign-administered area, not an alleged measured 1937 political or military boundary.
constraints: Includes only a central public-settlement/French-concession core and the approximate internment region.
Sihang Warehouse is north of the boundary; Nanshi and the old South Station are not protected core.
Hongkou and Yangshupu, despite settlement-related administration, remain combat theatre and can show Japanese positions.
The western Suzhou Creek south bank is not excluded wholesale and can show continuing Chinese defence.
Protected from Japanese combat tint is not synonymous with safety from bombing or shelling.
No sovereign international state, whole-concession polygon or precisely located foreign defence line is asserted.
foreignDefendedCore.implementation: The same single source ring generates data/overlays.json and INT/otherLandBit6. Campaign-builder also reads it to remove the core from Japanese city-control polygons. Exclusion is therefore physical mask and control geometry, not merely a disclaimer.
